notes: Camera-side ports only (this is a PTZ camera, not a display/rack device — rackUnits omitted, it's a ceiling/desktop-mount unit). Two independent SDI BNC outputs exist: "3G SDI OUT" (outputs 3G-SDI or 1.5G-SDI depending on format) and "12G SDI OUT" (outputs 12G-SDI, 6G-SDI, 3G-SDI or 1.5G-SDI depending on format) — graded at each port's maximum stated capability. HDMI is HDMI 2.0 (4:2:2/10-bit) per manufacturer spec page. RS-422 uses an RJ-45 connector shell but is NOT Ethernet — it carries RS-422A serial protocol for legacy PTZ controllers (e.g. AW-RP150); modeled as connector "rj45" since RS422/RS485 in the connector enum did not match the physical shell, and grade was intentionally omitted (RJ45 grade scale is for Ethernet speed, not applicable to serial-over-RJ45). LAN port supports 100BASE-TX/1000BASE-T (graded eth-1g) plus PoE++ (IEEE802.3bt) for power. DC IN connector polarity marking (⊖⊙⊕) in the Panasonic manual is the standard notation for a coaxial/barrel DC power jack, used with the supplied AC adaptor (12V DC, 10.8-13.2V, 3.0A) — modeled as dc-barrel; an earlier ambiguous web search result mentioning a "4-pin XLR power cable" was found to reference a different Panasonic PTZ model family (AW-UE150/HE145/HR140), not the UE100, and was discarded after the official manual confirmed the barrel-jack marking. No USB port exists on this model (confirmed absent in manual's parts diagram and index). A chassis ground screw terminal exists but was omitted as it is not a signal/power port in the requested taxonomy. Sources cross-checked: Panasonic Global spec page (pro-av.panasonic.net/en/products/aw-ue100/spec.html) and the official Operating/Installation Instructions PDF (pro-av.panasonic.net/manual/pdf/AW-UE100P.PJ_simple(DVQX2119ZA)_E.pdf), which provided the exact rear-panel connector labels and diagrams (pages 35-37).
